configuration: 24 May 1941; no Tirpitz additions; standard-draft display
authoringBoundary: blueprint.json and original catalog polygons only. Reference renderer outputs raster evidence; production geometry never consumes game offsets or attachment transforms.

frameRegistration.note: Frame 122.50 at overall midpoint is an adopted registration, not a verified builder datum. Relative turret distances are documented; absolute positions share this uncertainty.

coordinates.loadState: Standard 9.33 m draft for reproducible geometry; battle-day draft/trim varies and is not simulated historically. Overall, waterline and keel-relative measurements remain separate.

parameterGroups.note: Independent reconstruction, using rounded bilges and flared forebody. No archival offsets acquired. Section tolerance is an uncertainty label, not an archival section pass.
Build checks exact registration; all absolute positions inherit ±0.5 m frame datum uncertainty.
Yaw/roller datum interpreted from deck and gunhouse silhouette, not source model transforms.

Original planar roof, shoulder and lower-wall facets interpreted at the retained plan scale. Longer rear overhang and narrower sides replace the old full-height sloped box. The same versioned component facets compile to physical armor; bore, pivot and barrel axes retained.
Each significant footprint, base and height is editable. The archival excerpt confirms deck order but has no usable scale/title block.

parameterGroups.valueLocation: blueprint.json; each plate has thickness, material, geometry and provenance
parameterGroups.note: Thickness families documented; boundary positions and corner assignments estimated. Mid-surface planes, actual thickness in inspection, single crossing in CPU probes. Teak is physical backing with zero steel-equivalent resistance.

Six boiler rooms forward of wing turbines, center turbine farther aft; magazines above shell rooms. Precise walls, auxiliary rooms, fuel cells and shaft passages are approximate envelopes, not a complete general arrangement.
Standard displacement selected from source; HP, compartment usable volume, reserve threshold (10000 m³) and handling are gameplay calibration. No derived hydrostatics claim.

parameterGroups.selector: build.py: bridge galleries, conning support, funnel cap/platforms, directors, aircraft handling, AA and deck fittings
parameterGroups.valueLocation: blueprint.structures and original build.py detail recipe
parameterGroups.note: 24 May reconstruction reread on a 5 m grid. Conning director moved from x=35,z=15 to x=27.6,z=20.6 in Blender axes; physical support now modeled. Funnel reference-height/cap rake revised. Detailed fitting dimensions remain image estimates; no game geometry or attachment data used.

198 authored stations with 25 half-section points. Curved upper stem and nearly vertical lower forefoot replace the straight rake. Waterline endpoints redistributed to 2.65 and 244.20 m from the overall stern, preserving 241.55 m LWL. Raster profile and loading datum leave about 1 m endpoint uncertainty; this is not an acquired body plan.

20 mm ordinary hull steel and 8 mm superstructure steel are provisional gameplay values. Hull sections, deckhouse polygons, tower taper and funnel jacket supply renderer-free collision and inspection surfaces. Nearby exterior armor replaces nominal shell plating.

24 original facets replace the full-height tapered box: rear roof ridge, falling forward roof, clipped nose and near-vertical side walls. Roof/face thickness families follow retained 150mmp.gif. Barrel and yaw axes preserved; middle pair retain local rangefinders. Polygon dimensions, blast bags and fittings remain interpretations.

Separate forward navigation wheelhouse and narrow conning enclosure/crown. Recessed gallery centers and projecting wings replace repeated wide slabs; glazing follows actual chamfered walls. Conning enclosure remains provisional 8 mm structural collision, without a verified conning armor schedule.

parameterGroups.valueLocation: blueprint.json; fit-transverse-armor.py edits the six stable IDs
parameterGroups.note: Convex plate boundaries fit hull half-sections at both physical faces with 25 mm inward clearance. Lower aft plate respects the local rising keel. Layer heights/thickness families retained except clipping the lower edge to the hull; no renderer-only offset or hiding.

historicalRegistration.method: One uniform pixel/metre scale for all three views, from overall hull endpoints. Vertical profile uses keel datum, retaining source proportions. No independent height or component fit.
historicalRegistration.limits: Raster endpoints and keel read manually. Waterline from keel+9.33 m is a registration datum, not a claim about the drawing's depicted load. Crops preserve the original alongside derivatives.

review.title: Bismarck · 24 May 1941
review.intro: Independent reconstruction at a 9.33 m standard draft. Compare the exported ship with GameModels3D and historical drawings, using fixed cameras and a single scale registration.
review.historicalLabel: Historical reconstruction · González López · uniform scale, keel registration
review.limits: Body-plan offsets and exact bridge/gunhouse dimensions remain estimates. The fourth pass corrects secondary roof profiles, separates the navigation/conning bridge and fits transverse armor within the hull. The reference game retains its own proportions and unknown load; export checks do not certify historical accuracy.
